source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: As the [first battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) opens, you may name one enemy unit as this unit’s **mark**. The unit can reroll **[Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)** that show 1 for attacks against its **mark**. When its **mark** is destroyed, name an enemy unit as the replacement.
